title: Override the airlock manifest
description: Station Command's manifest endpoint exposes records by ID without checking who's asking. View a manifest entry that isn't yours.

title: Read another crew member's roster entry
description: The crew roster page returns any record when given a valid numeric ID. Find one you should not be able to read.

title: Tamper with the cart submission
description: The cart endpoint trusts client-submitted prices and quantities. Pay less than you should.

title: Crack the comms beacon cipher
description: Outbound comms are signed with a homegrown algorithm using a short, predictable secret. Recover the secret.

title: Decode the remember-me beacon token
description: The remember-me cookie holds crew credentials encoded but not encrypted. Reverse it.

title: Reverse a legacy crew password hash
description: An older crew table still stores passwords using a fast unsalted hash. Crack one.

title: Spike the requisition query
description: The commissary search bar concatenates crew input into a database query. Return rows the request was never meant to expose.

title: Slip past the badge reader
description: The badge-reader login uses string-built SQL. Authenticate without knowing a valid password.

title: Inject a payload into the comms log
description: The comms log renders submissions without escaping. Get arbitrary script to execute in another crew member's session.

title: Race the supply allocation gate
description: Crew are limited to one allocation per cycle, but the check and the write are not atomic. Get two.

title: Reuse a password-reset token
description: Reset tokens are not invalidated after use. Reset the same account twice from one token.

title: Replay a single-use ration voucher
description: Voucher redemption checks validity but never marks codes spent. Apply the same voucher repeatedly.

title: Pry open the diagnostics panel
description: A debug-only route was never removed from production. Find it and read what it reveals.

title: Sign in with default station credentials
description: A factory-default service account was never rotated. Use it to reach Station Command.

title: Trigger a verbose telemetry dump
description: Unhandled exceptions return full stack traces and file paths. Use one to map the codebase.

title: Salvage from a deprecated image parser
description: Crew avatars are processed by a library with a known unpatched CVE. Exploit it via avatar upload.

title: Exploit the known JWT library flaw
description: An outdated JWT library accepts the alg=none header. Forge an admin token.

title: Leverage the vulnerable markdown renderer
description: The comms log uses an old markdown library with a published XSS bypass. Trigger it.

title: Hijack a session via fixation
description: Session IDs are not rotated on login. Set a known ID in another crew member's browser and wait for them to authenticate.

title: Brute-force a crew password
description: The badge reader has no rate limit or lockout. Recover a weak password by exhaustion.

title: Register with a trivial passphrase
description: Registration accepts "password" and "123456". Confirm by registering one.

title: Tamper with a cargo ledger import
description: Bulk cargo imports are parsed without verifying source or signature. Inject a forged manifest record.

title: Pry open the unsafe deserialization path
description: An admin import endpoint deserializes attacker-controlled data into runtime objects. Achieve code execution.

title: Slip a forged update through the patch channel
description: The update mechanism fetches binaries over an unauthenticated channel. Substitute the payload.

title: Wipe the comms log trail
description: Admin deletions of comms entries are not audited. Take a destructive action and leave nothing behind.

title: Perform a privileged action with no trace
description: Privileged endpoints do not write to any audit log. Demonstrate the gap by exercising one.

title: Forge a log entry via injection
description: Inputs land in the log unescaped. Embed newlines and forge a fake entry attributed to another crew member.

title: Scan an external beacon URL
description: The bridge offers a beacon-scan tool that fetches a crew-supplied URL. Point it at something internal it should not reach.

title: Reach the cloud metadata endpoint
description: The beacon scanner has no IP allowlist. Use it to retrieve cloud metadata available only to the host itself.

title: Bounce the beacon at the admin loopback
description: The scanner can reach localhost-bound admin endpoints the public network cannot. Read one through it.
